author_reading_scope: Read the complete relevant passages of both full-text treatments. Mohri, Rostamizadeh and Talwalkar: full 505-page second-edition PDF; Chapter 3 §3.1, Definitions 3.1–3.2 and Theorem 3.3 with complete proof, printed pp. 30–33; Chapter 5 §5.4, Lemma 5.7 with complete proof, printed pp. 93–94. Bartlett and Mendelson: complete 20-page JMLR PDF; Definition 2, Theorem 5 and Appendix B proof, Theorems 7–9, Theorem 12 and proof, Appendix A proof of Lemma 3, and Appendix B. The official author PDF redirect failed in the web reader and the official HTML preview timed out; an alternative mirror was located but not used, then the author-linked PDF was downloaded directly and inspected. The official JMLR full paper was opened and inspected. Both actual full bodies were subsequently fetched and stamped by source-fetch-check. No source was dropped. The B&M absolute/$2/m normalization, its zero-at-zero contraction premise, and the confidence-omitting Theorem 1 introductory display were kept separate from the authored claims.
